lines.hanzi: 我最喜欢的城市是北京。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan de chéngshì shì Běijīng.

lines.hanzi: 北京是中国的大城市，很大。
lines.pinyin: Běijīng shì Zhōngguó de dà chéngshì, hěn dà.
lines.english: Beijing is a big city in China, very large.

lines.hanzi: 我去过两次，每次都住一周。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ qù guò liǎng cì, měi cì dōu zhù yī zhōu.
lines.english: I've been there twice, each time staying a week.

lines.hanzi: 公园里走走，看花看树，很放心。
lines.pinyin: Gōngyuán lǐ zǒuzou, kàn huā kàn shù, hěn fàngxīn.
lines.english: Walking in the park, looking at flowers and trees, is very relaxing.

lines.hanzi: 那里的茶也很好，茶馆很多。
lines.pinyin: Nàlǐ de chá yě hěn hǎo, cháguǎn hěn duō.
lines.english: The tea there is also good, and there are many tea houses.

lines.hanzi: 那里的菜好吃，我喜欢吃。
lines.pinyin: Nàlǐ de cài hǎochī, wǒ xǐhuan chī.
lines.english: The food there is delicious, I like to eat it.

lines.hanzi: 城市很干净，地铁方便，去哪儿都容易。
lines.pinyin: Chéngshì hěn gānjìng, dìtiě fāngbiàn, qù nǎr dōu róngyì.
lines.english: The city is very clean, the subway is convenient, and going anywhere is easy.

lines.hanzi: 人也很友好，说话很好听。
lines.pinyin: Rén yě hěn yǒuhǎo, shuōhuà hěn hǎotīng.
lines.english: The people are also friendly, and they speak very nicely.

lines.hanzi: 希望以后有机会住在那里。
lines.pinyin: Xīwàng yǐhòu yǒu jīhuì zhù zài nàlǐ.
lines.english: I hope in the future I'll have a chance to live there.
